scope: One fixed-seed, two-arm system BETWEEN transfer. Accepted A17 has one TEACH-AIR-01 in each of two explicit units at two bases, serving a two-aircraft group mission at h8. Both arms add a second group mission at h20. The between arm requests one TEACH-AIR-01 from TEACH-UNIT to TEACH-UNIT-2 at h8.5 with TFDT0.5 while its first mission is active; control has an all-null SystemTransfer placeholder.

manual.rule: SystemTransfer moves systems between explicit units by UFID/UTID/SID/TFTIME key. A source system must leave the ready pool; a busy system waits for readiness. BETWEEN uses TFDT as transport delay. TFPRI is documented as unused.

frozen_delta: Both arms derive from byte-pinned A17 and add the same second OperationProfile record at STIM20, an eight-column SystemTransfer table, and an arm description. Control has an all-null transfer placeholder. Between has one TEACH-UNIT to TEACH-UNIT-2 transfer row at TFTIME8.5, TFQTY1, TFDT0.5. Other A17 model rows remain fixed.
acceptance_hypotheses: Both inputs import, exactly roundtrip authored populated tables, calculate and export native logs/reports with zero converter errors and only reviewed warnings in a guarded session-0 SSH run.

The h8 first formation uses two stable system identities, and a requested h8.5 transfer does not remove the busy source system until it becomes ready after that mission. One physical BETWEEN movement takes TFDT0.5, changes source/target unit rosters without duplicating the aircraft, and preserves two total systems.

The h20 second group formation and report system/mission bins reconcile with the changed unit deployment. If unit-level attribution or a stable system identity cannot be observed, publish only the narrower physical movement actually evidenced.
gate: Publish only if frozen pins, guarded native closure, exact authored-table roundtrips, independent log/report replay, first and second mission behavior, one delayed BETWEEN movement and no duplicated system identity pass. Otherwise retain a diagnostic and freeze a new version.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, protected GUI PID13340/session1 identity, immutable run path, targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One fixed seed, two explicit units at two bases, one system type, one requested BETWEEN and one group schedule. No IN/OUT, transfer priority setting, PM state retention, shortages, GUI, cross-engine parity, or general I04/Issue #18 claim.
